title: Tiki Standard Product Return and Exchange Policy and Conditions
content: Customers may request an exchange or return within 30 days (for products directly distributed by Tiki Trading) or within 7 days (for products from marketplace partner sellers on Tiki) from the date of successful delivery. Returned products must have intact security seals, complete original packaging, accessories, invoices, and included promotional gifts, and show no signs of usage or laundering.

title: Return and Exchange Request Process and Steps on Tiki App
content: To create a return or exchange request, customers navigate to 'Account' > 'Order Management' > select the order with 'Delivered' status > tap 'Request Return/Exchange'. Customers select the reason and upload 3-5 clear photos or a video demonstrating the product defect. Once the request is received by Tiki, shipping couriers will pick up the item directly from the customer's address for free within 1-2 business days, or customers may drop off the package at designated Tiki partner post offices.

title: Restricted Return Categories and Non-Returnable Change-of-Mind Items on Tiki
content: Product categories that do not support returns due to change of mind or personal preference include: Underwear, swimwear, cosmetics and chemicals with unsealed protective packaging, Tiki Ngon fresh groceries, dietary supplements, mobile top-up scratch cards, electronic service vouchers, and clearance outlet items marked as non-returnable. These items are only eligible for return or exchange if Tiki delivered an incorrect item or if there is a verified manufacturer defect.

title: Exchange Regulations for Incorrect Size or Color Selection
content: For fashion and footwear products purchased on Tiki, customers are supported with size or color exchanges within 7 days of delivery. Customers contact the seller via the Tiki Chat feature to select a replacement size. If the exchange is due to the customer's personal choice while the delivered product matches the description, the customer is responsible for two-way postal shipping fees.

title: Return and Exchange Regulations for Items Damaged or Broken in Transit
content: In cases where a product is dented, scratched, cracked, broken, or deformed during Tiki shipping, customers must notify Tiki Customer Support within 48 hours of delivery. Customers are advised to retain the original packaging and provide a co-inspection receipt or an unboxing video to receive priority dispatch of a replacement item within 24 hours at no extra cost.

title: Return and Exchange Policy for Tech Goods and Electronic Devices
content: Smartphones, tablets, laptops, and cameras purchased on Tiki are eligible for a 1-to-1 replacement within the first 30 days if hardware defects caused by the manufacturer occur (certified by the brand's authorized service center). Customers must return the device to the inspection warehouse complete with all original accessories, charging cables, user manuals, and the original box matching the IMEI/Serial number.

title: Inspection and Response Timeline for Returned Goods at Tiki Warehouse
content: When returned packages arrive at the Tiki fulfillment center, technical staff will conduct aesthetic and functional inspections within 2-3 business days. The inspection outcome (Refund Approved or Rejected due to policy violation) will be notified automatically via the Tiki app and the customer's registered email.

title: Partial Return Regulations for Multi-Item Orders
content: Customers have the right to return one or more specific items from a multi-item order (partial return), except for items that are part of a bundle package or promotional gifts accompanying the main product. The refunded amount will be calculated by Tiki based on the actual value of each item after deducting the proportional allocation of applied Tiki discount vouchers.

title: Safe Refund Reconciliation Rules and Principles on Tiki
content: Refund requests are only processed once an order has been successfully canceled prior to dispatch, or after the Tiki warehouse receives and inspects the returned product to standard. All refund decisions must undergo reconciliation by authorized customer service personnel; AI is prohibited from autonomously approving monetary transactions. Original shipping fees are non-refundable if the return reason is based on personal preference.

title: Refund Receipt Timeline by Payment Method on Tiki
content: The timeline for receiving a refund on Tiki depends on the original payment method: For Tiki Coins Wallet, refunds are credited within 24 hours. For linked e-wallets (MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay, Viettel Money), funds are returned to the wallet within 1-2 business days. For domestic Napas ATM cards, the timeline is 3-5 business days. For international credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, JCB), issuing banks process within 7-15 business days (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays).

title: Discount Voucher (Tiki Coupon) and Shipping Fee Refund Policy
content: When an order is canceled or approved for a 100% return refund, Tiki discount coupons will automatically be returned to the customer's coupon wallet within 1-3 hours, provided the coupon is still within its validity period. Seller discount coupons (Shop Coupons) and used Free Shipping coupons will not be reissued. Paid shipping fees are only refunded if the fault lies with Tiki or the seller.

title: Handling Incorrect Refund Account Details or Locked Bank Accounts
content: If a customer's bank account or e-wallet phone number is locked, changed, or entered incorrectly when requesting a refund, the Tiki system will send a transaction failure notification. Customers must contact Tiki Customer Support directly (hotline 1900 6035) and provide identification verification photos (ID card) along with confirmation of the new account details for Tiki accounting to manually update the transfer order within 48 hours.

title: Refund Regulations for Cash on Delivery (COD) Payments
content: For orders paid via cash on delivery (COD) that are subsequently approved for a return refund, Tiki supports two refund methods: Credited as Tiki Coins within 24 hours (with an additional 5% bonus value) or direct bank transfer within 3-5 business days. Customers provide their Account Number, Account Holder Name, and Beneficiary Bank Branch on the Tiki app.

title: Refund Reconciliation for 0% Installment Orders on Tiki
content: For electronics and tech orders purchased through 0% credit card installment plans on Tiki that are canceled or returned, the refund amount will be remitted by Tiki to partner banks to be credited directly against the card's upcoming billing statement. Card-issuing banks require 1 to 3 business weeks to cancel the installment contract and restore the cardholder's available credit limit.

title: Checking Refund History and Order Status on Tiki
content: Customers can monitor refund progress by accessing 'Account Details' > 'Return & Refund Management'. Refund statuses include: 'Reconciliation Processing' (under customer support review), 'Transferred to Bank' (funds dispatched from Tiki, awaiting bank credit), and 'Refund Succeeded' along with the bank's transaction tracing reference code.

title: Estimated Delivery Timelines and Tiki Shipping Service Packages
content: Estimated delivery times on Tiki are categorized by service package: TikiNOW Express delivers within 2 hours in inner districts of Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and Da Nang. Fast Delivery delivers within 1-2 business days across major urban centers. Standard Delivery takes 3-5 business days for inter-provincial orders or rural districts. During severe weather or peak holiday seasons, delivery may be extended by 1-2 additional days.

title: Shipping Fee Schedule and Shipping Support Policy (Freeship TikiPRO)
content: Shipping fees on Tiki are calculated automatically based on distance and parcel weight: Intra-city orders carry a base fee of 18,000 VND to 25,000 VND. Inter-provincial orders range from 35,000 VND to 55,000 VND. Customers with TikiPRO memberships or orders meeting the minimum value of 149,000 VND can apply Freeship discount vouchers for up to 30,000 VND - 70,000 VND in shipping discounts. The final shipping fee is displayed transparently on the checkout page.

title: Tiki Parcel Co-Inspection Policy upon Delivery
content: Tiki supports an open-box co-inspection policy: Customers are entitled to request the courier for co-inspection before signing for receipt or paying COD. Co-inspection scope covers: opening outer shipping cartons to verify quantity, product names, sizes, and checking exterior condition for dents, scratches, cracks, or damage. Co-inspection does not include breaking manufacturer factory seals or powering on devices for testing. If discrepancies are found, customers may reject receipt.

title: Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
content: In the event a Tiki order exceeds its estimated delivery date without arrival, or if a courier marks an order as 'Successfully Delivered' when the customer has not received the parcel, the customer must contact Tiki Customer Support within 24-48 hours via hotline 1900 6035. Tiki's dispatch team will verify courier GPS logs, coordinate with the delivery hub, and resolve the complaint. If an order is lost, Tiki will dispatch a replacement or issue a 100% refund.

title: Multiple Delivery Attempts and Post Office Holding Period
content: Tiki delivery couriers will attempt contact up to 3 times on different days to deliver the parcel. If the customer is unavailable or does not answer during all 3 attempts, the parcel will be held at the nearest delivery post office for 5 days. Customers may proactively contact the courier hotline to reschedule delivery or visit the post office directly with the tracking code to collect the package before it is returned to the Tiki warehouse.

title: Installation and Bulky Goods Transport Service TikiPRO
content: For oversized items such as refrigerators, washing machines, clothes dryers, and TVs 50 inches and above, the TikiPRO service deploys dedicated transport trucks and supports exact delivery appointment scheduling. TikiPRO technicians assist with carrying items upstairs and provide free on-site installation (for standard setups). Customers sign an operational acceptance handover document before final handover.

title: Delivery Policy for Island Districts and Remote Areas
content: Tiki orders shipped to island districts (Phu Quoc, Con Dao, Ly Son, Co To...) or remote mountainous communes have delivery timelines of 5 to 8 business days depending on sea ferry schedules and weather conditions. Shipping fees to these regions may include a remote area surcharge displayed clearly upon entering the destination address.

title: Delivery Regulations for Saturdays, Sundays, and Public Holidays
content: Tiki standard and fast delivery services operate from Monday through Saturday (8:00 AM - 6:00 PM). On Sundays and national public holidays, standard delivery partners suspend dispatching parcels, whereas the TikiNOW 2-hour express delivery package continues uninterrupted service across urban districts of Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.

title: Instructions for Tracking Order Journey and Status on Tiki
content: Customers can check order status by navigating to 'My Orders' on the Tiki app. Order statuses include: 'Pending Confirmation' (seller preparing), 'Pick Up in Progress' (packed, awaiting courier), 'In Transit' (courier delivering, real-time tracking code provided), 'Delivered' (completed), and 'Canceled'. Customers tap the tracking code to view details of each transit hub the parcel has passed through.

title: Order Cancellation Rules and Conditions on Tiki
content: Customers can click 'Cancel Order' directly on the Tiki app if the order is in 'Processing' or 'Awaiting Packing' status and has not yet been handed over to the shipping carrier. Once the order transitions to 'In Transit', the direct cancellation button is disabled; customers should reject the package upon courier contact. For canceled prepaid orders, refunds will be issued automatically according to Tiki refund policies.

title: Instructions for Changing Delivery Address or Phone Number After Placing Order
content: Customers may change the delivery address or phone number only once per order, provided the order remains in 'Pending Processing' status. When an order advances to 'Preparing Items' or 'Handed Over to Courier', modification features are locked to prevent parcel misrouting. Customers should contact the courier upon phone contact to arrange delivery at a nearby location.

title: Electronic Value Added Tax (VAT) Invoice Issuance on Tiki
content: To request a VAT invoice for a Tiki order, customers must check 'Request VAT Invoice' and provide Company Name, Tax Identification Number, Company Address, and Recipient Email at the checkout stage. The deadline to request an invoice is within 7 days of successful order delivery. Valid electronic invoices adhering to General Department of Taxation regulations are delivered via email within 3-5 business days.

title: Order Consolidation and Parcel Splitting Regulations
content: Tiki automatically splits an order into separate packages if items belong to different marketplace sellers or originate from fulfillment centers in different regions. Consequently, parcels may be delivered at different times and by different couriers. Customers cannot request to combine two individually placed orders into a single shipment.

title: Handling Orders Canceled by Seller or Due to Out-of-Stock Inventory
content: If a seller on Tiki is unable to supply goods due to depleted inventory or discovered defects and cancels the order, the Tiki system sends an apology notification along with a compensatory Tiki coupon. If the order was prepaid, 100% of the funds will be automatically refunded within 24 business hours.

title: Reviewing Purchase History and Completed Orders on Tiki
content: Customers can review their complete order history on Tiki spanning up to 2 years by navigating to 'My Orders' > filtering by 'Delivered' or 'Canceled' status. Customers can re-download electronic invoices or click 'Buy Again' to quickly reorder favorite items.

title: Handling Payment Incidents and Banking Transactions on Tiki
content: If a customer's bank account or e-wallet is debited but the order on Tiki remains in 'Awaiting Payment' status or fails to display, this is typically due to transmission latency from the payment gateway. The Tiki system and payment gateway automatically reconcile and update the order within 15-30 minutes. If the order remains unconfirmed after 1 hour, the system will automatically refund the original payment account within 24-72 business hours.

title: Safe Payment Methods Supported on Tiki
content: Tiki supports a variety of secure payment methods: Cash on Delivery (COD), E-wallets (MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay, Viettel Money), Domestic Napas ATM cards across over 40 banks, International credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, JCB), Apple Pay, and Co-branded Tiki Shinhan Credit Cards. For orders valued over 20 million VND, Tiki enforces an upfront online payment policy.

title: Security Warnings and Account Safety for Tiki Transactions
content: To ensure transaction security, customers must never share OTP verification codes, bank passwords, or e-wallet PINs with anyone, including individuals claiming to be Tiki Customer Support agents. Tiki systems never request customers to transfer money into personal bank accounts for prizes or dispute resolutions. If suspicious transactions are detected, immediately freeze bank cards and contact Tiki hotline 1900 6035.

title: Handling Double Deductions on Credit Cards or E-Wallets
content: In instances where network congestion causes a transaction to be recorded and charged twice for the same Tiki order code, Tiki's automated reconciliation system and partner banks will detect the duplicate charge during end-of-day settlement and refund the excess amount to the card within 48 business hours without requiring a formal dispute claim.

title: Eligibility and Instructions for Buy Now Pay Later on Tiki
content: Buy Now Pay Later services (partnered with Home PayLater and Kredivo on Tiki) allow customers to make purchases upfront and pay across terms of 1, 3, 6, or 12 months with credit limits based on credit history. Customers aged 18 and older with a valid chip-based national ID can activate the service directly within the Tiki app in 3 minutes without proof of income.

title: Maximum Cash on Delivery (COD) Payment Limit on Tiki
content: To ensure courier safety and prevent fraud risks, Cash on Delivery (COD) on Tiki is only available for orders with a total payment value under 20,000,000 VND. Orders valued at 20 million VND and above must be prepaid via bank transfer, e-wallet, or credit card.

title: Genuine Electronics and Home Appliances Warranty Policy on Tiki
content: Genuine electronic, technology, and home appliance products purchased on Tiki carry standard warranties from 12 to 24 months according to manufacturer regulations. Customers can claim warranty service directly at brand-authorized service centers nationwide using their Tiki electronic invoice or warranty certificate, or contact Tiki for free courier pickup and delivery to the brand's repair center.

title: Electronic Warranty (e-Warranty) Activation Process
content: For brands utilizing electronic warranties (such as Samsung, Sony, LG, Panasonic, and Xiaomi purchased on Tiki), the warranty is automatically activated based on the Serial Number 3 days after the order transitions to Successfully Delivered status. Customers can also self-activate by scanning the QR code on the warranty slip or sending an SMS according to instructions printed on the product packaging.

title: Instances Ineligible for Free Warranty Coverage
content: Products will be ineligible for complimentary warranty service and converted to paid repair services under the following circumstances: Products that are dropped, cracked, water-damaged, damaged by lightning strikes or power surges, infested by insects, tampered with or disassembled by unauthorized repair shops, or having torn, altered, or erased warranty seals and serial numbers.

title: Repair and Warranty Processing Timelines
content: Standard warranty turnaround times typically range from 7 to 14 business days from the moment the service center receives the device (excluding transit time). In cases where replacement components must be imported from overseas, the authorized service center will issue a specific rescheduled completion notice via the Tiki app.

title: Included Accessory Warranty Policy (Chargers, Cables, Earphones)
content: Accessories bundled inside the main product box (such as charging adapters, cables, earphones, and remote controls) carry warranty coverage from 3 to 6 months depending on individual brand policies. Built-in non-removable device batteries carry a 12-month warranty alongside the main unit, while detachable batteries carry a 6-month warranty.

title: In-Home Warranty Service for Large TikiPRO Appliances
content: For bulky appliances such as refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, and TVs 43 inches and above purchased on Tiki, authorized brand technicians will travel directly to the customer's home address to perform on-site diagnosis and repair. Customers simply call the brand hotline or contact Tiki Customer Support to provide their Serial Number and schedule an appointment.

title: Direct Tiki Customer Support Contact Channels and Operating Hours
content: Customers can connect directly with support representatives through official Tiki channels: Customer Support hotline 1900 6035 (operating from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, fee 1,000 VND/minute), 24/7 Live Chat via the Tiki app, or email at hotro@tiki.vn. For urgent matters concerning financial disputes and unauthorized charges, Tiki customer support prioritizes resolution within 2-4 hours.

title: Complaint and Dispute Resolution Process Between Buyers and Sellers
content: When disputes arise regarding product quality or merchant service conduct where parties cannot reach an agreement, customers can click 'Dispute Seller' in their Tiki order details. Tiki acts as an independent intermediary arbiter, requiring both buyer and seller to submit supporting evidence (packaging video, unboxing video, defect photos). Final resolution decisions are issued by Tiki within 3 to 5 business days.

title: Consumer Protection Policy and Tiki 100% Genuine Authenticity Guarantee
content: Tiki guarantees 100% of products sold on the platform are authentic with verified origins. If a customer identifies and demonstrates that an item purchased on Tiki is counterfeit or fraudulent, Tiki commits to a 111% refund of the order value and initiates permanent seller account termination in accordance with consumer protection standards.

title: Product Review and Feedback Guidelines on Tiki
content: Customers who have received orders successfully are entitled to submit ratings from 1 to 5 stars along with authentic photos/videos on Tiki. Comments containing profanity, defamatory remarks, or external promotional links will be automatically hidden or removed by the system according to Tiki Community Standards.

title: Customer Loyalty Program and Tiki Coins Reward Points
content: Every successfully completed order on Tiki accrues reward Tiki Coins (1,000 VND spent earns 1 Coin). Customers can apply Tiki Coins directly as discounts on future orders (up to 50% of total order value). Tiki Coins remain valid for 12 months from the date of accrual.

title: Legacy Warranty Policy Applicable Prior to 2024
content: Legacy warranty policy version applicable prior to January 1, 2024. This document has expired and is legally void; it must not be used as grounds for customer advisory. All new warranty inquiries must strictly adhere to Warranty Policy Version 2.0 (POL-WARRANTY-001).

title: Lunar New Year 2023 Coin Cashback Promotion
content: Promotional program offering 50% coin cashback for fashion orders during Lunar New Year 2023 on Tiki. This promotional campaign concluded on January 31, 2023. This document is expired and possesses no valid offer reference for customers at the present time.

title: 2022 Product Return and Exchange Regulations
content: Regulatory document stipulating a 3-day return window effective during 2022 on Tiki. This regulation has been revoked and entirely superseded by the current 7-30 day policy. The system prohibits referencing this document for dispute resolution advisory.
